label: Relay Defense part2

tooling.reasoning: GLM high; other Ollama arms medium; Qwen/local numeric thinking cap 2048. Not equal reasoning controls.

timingScope: Active model/agent phases including tool waits; excludes setup, loading, outside coordination, independent review and gaps. Earlier four runs overlapped unintended calibration; not an isolated speed benchmark.
ratingScope: Owner personal stars have not been assigned. Reader selections remain browser-local; no shared averages or ratings backend is enabled for part2.
authorship: The selected models authored game source and procedural assets through Pi. Outside assistance handled setup, prompts, packaging, independent checks and editorial assets.

runs.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
runs.controls: Start, dismiss tutorial, choose 1/2 then click a pad. Select a tower to upgrade/sell. Space sends a wave. P pause, S speed, M mute, R restart.
runs.note: Six-wave victory with 82 kills, 20/20 integrity and 0 leaks. Paid upgrades, sales, spending limits and normal controls checked. Canvas scales to phone width.

runs.title: Inkling 2 Small
runs.controls: Start, choose a tower using the lower buttons, then click sand. Escape cancels placement; select a tower to upgrade/sell. Space starts waves. Use the visible pause/speed/sound/restart buttons.
runs.note: Six-wave victory with 10 lives remaining. Economy and both restart routes checked. Fixed-width canvas crops at 390px; desktop recommended.

runs.title: Qwen3.8-Flash
runs.controls: Start Mission and close tutorial. 1/2 select towers; click sand. Space sends waves, P pause, S speed, M mute, R restart. Upgrade/sell controls have known defects.
runs.note: First pass left the starter unchanged; one recovery produced a playable campaign. Normal upgrade/sell clicks failed. The time hook bypasses pause. Canvas crops at 390px.

runs.title: Inkling Small UD-IQ1_S
runs.controls: Click the starter menu once to inspect the failure. The blank screen is the recorded result, not a working game.
runs.note: Preserved failed artifact. Starter menu leads to a blank screen. Build passes but the game entry points are mismatched. Older extreme IQ1 quantization with text-only input; not equivalent to cloud Inkling 2.
runs.qualification: Older local model with extreme quantization and serving/tool-format problems; not a paired test of cloud Inkling 2.

runs.title: GLM-5.3-Flash
runs.controls: Start and dismiss tutorial. 1/2 build, click sand, select tower then U or UPGRADE. P pause, F speed, M mute, R restart. Call a wave early for the designed 15-credit bonus.
runs.note: Six-wave victory, loss, paid upgrades and restarts checked. One visual-feedback phase fixed unreadable shop buttons/HUD hints. Final changes only affect UI. Canvas scales to phone width.
